verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a database product like Chroma, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a delete operation, TTL/retention policies, or data-erasure guarantees. Self-hosting, BYOC and point-in-time recovery are deployment or resilience features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
